{{Quote|Thank the Maker! This oil bath is going to feel so good.|C-3PO|<ref name="Episode 4">{{Film|IV}}</ref>}}
'''The Maker''', also known '''The One Who Creates''', was a being often referred to in deity-like terms by [[Droid/Legends|droids]]. Droids claimed that the Maker was the being that created the first droid. He changed them from simple machines into intelligent creations. Another belief was that The Maker was actually the first droid.<ref name="Scavenger's Guide to Droids">''[[Scavenger's Guide to Droids]]''</ref>

It seemed curious that new droids would possess knowledge of the Maker, which led to two conclusions: new droids were told by old droids, creating a chain, or droid manufacturers included knowledge of the Maker in droid programming to make them easier to control.

The Maker was also central to the religion of the [[Sunesi]] people, who also called him '''the Giver'''. They viewed him as the giver of life and a master being "with a fine and glorious creativity and affection," often adding a ''sense of humor'' to his qualities.<ref name="Only Droids Serve the Maker">{{JournalCite|10|Only Droids Serve the Maker}}</ref>

[[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]] may have believed in a Maker as well; she said to [[Kyle Katarn]], "May the Maker help me if I'm wrong, but I'm going to take a chance on you."<ref name="Dark Forces: Soldier for the Empire">''[[Dark Forces: Soldier for the Empire]]'' (chapter 5)</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Maker is also invoked by [[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]] in ''[[Dark Forces: Soldier for the Empire]]'', hoping for its forgiveness, before trusting [[Kyle Katarn]] and assigning him [[Mission to Danuta|his first mission]]. In the [[Dark Forces: Soldier for the Empire (audio drama)|audio drama]], however, she instead says, "may the future forgive me if I am wrong."
